full_prompt_en: The image is a square, finely lined print-like fantasy illustration of two travelers riding a pale rushing creature, with an enormous blue beast emerging behind them in a dark teal setting. The background is nearly filled with layered blue-green curves and short directional marks, leaving little empty sky. A narrow vertical strip of tiny dark script sits at the upper right, but the individual characters are too small to read. In the upper left, one figure in pale loose clothing leans forward behind a second figure dressed in muted purple and deep blue. Their dark hair and faces are shown in profile, both oriented toward the right. The nearer rider bends low above the large pale animal, whose streaming mane occupies the central region. Fine gray contour lines trace the hair in long repeated sweeps, turning its bright mass into a textured focal point against the surrounding dark blue. A reddish strap crosses the animal's pale body and dark lines gather near its open mouth. The animal's eye and pointed muzzle face right, while its foreleg reaches down and forward across the lower center. Behind this pale body, a much larger blue head appears from the textured darkness. Its round light eye, ridged snout, and layered scale-like linework distinguish it from the flowing background, though its lower edge dissolves into those same turbulent curves. At the bottom, curling blue forms overlap pale ground and send the whole scene into a diagonal rush toward the lower right. The apparent light is concentrated on the pale body and faces, while the surrounding blue areas hold deeper shadow; this is a graphic division made through color and line density rather than a single visible sun. Firm outlines, densely repeated strokes, cream highlights, muted red cords, and worn paper texture give the fantastical action an intricate printed surface. The overall composition is crowded and energetic, with light and dark forms interlocking around a strong forward movement.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、线描细密且带版画感的奇幻插画：两位旅人骑在疾驰的浅色兽背上，巨大的蓝色兽形从他们后方、深青色环境中浮出。背景几乎被层叠的青蓝曲线与短小定向线条填满，少有空白天空。右上方有一道细窄的竖排小字，但单个字太小，无法读清。左上方，一名穿宽松浅衣的人物在另一名身穿低调紫色与深蓝衣物的人物身后前倾。两人的深发和脸都以侧面示出，朝向右方。较近的骑者俯身压在大型浅色动物之上，动物飘扬的鬃毛占据中央。细灰轮廓以长而重复的弧线描出毛发，使明亮的大块形体在周围深蓝色前成为有纹理的焦点。一条红褐色束带越过动物的浅色身体，张开的口边聚着深色线条。它的眼睛和尖吻朝右，前腿则向下向前伸到下方中央。浅色身体后面，一个大得多的蓝色头部从纹理密集的暗处出现。它的浅色圆眼、起伏的长吻和层层鳞状线描使它区别于流动背景，但下缘又溶入同样翻腾的曲线。底部，卷曲蓝形越过浅色地面，让全景形成冲向右下的斜向动势。光似乎集中在浅色身体和脸部，周围蓝色区域则留在较深阴影；这种明暗分割主要由色彩与线条密度完成，而非某个可见太阳。坚实轮廓、密集重复笔线、奶油色亮部、低调红色束带和磨旧纸纹赋予奇幻动作繁复的印刷表面。整体构图拥挤而有活力，明暗形体围绕强烈的前冲动作相互咬合。
style_prompt_en: A finely lined print-like illustration layers firm contours over dense directional strokes and lightly weathered color. Flowing curves repeat at several scales, making separate forms interlock while small, sharp accents keep the focal structure readable. Deep teal and blue-green occupy much of the field; cream and pale gray carve out a bright central mass, with narrow muted red strokes adding tension. Shading comes from compact line density and overlapping color rather than smooth gradients. Light areas retain visible hairline marks, and dark areas stay textured instead of becoming blank black. The framing is crowded, with diagonal movement carried through repeated arcs and cropped edges. An uneven paperlike surface softens the finish without obscuring its precise drawn contours. The overall effect is dramatic, intricate, and kinetic, with printed texture binding vivid contrast into one scene.
style_prompt_zh: 这种线描精细、带版画感的插画将坚实轮廓叠在密集的定向笔线上，并施以轻微磨旧的色彩。流动曲线在多个尺度重复，让不同形体相互咬合，同时以小而锐利的强调保留焦点结构的可读性。深青与蓝绿占据画面大部；奶油色和浅灰刻出明亮的中央块面，细窄的低调红线加入紧张感。阴影由紧凑线条密度与色层重叠构成，而非平滑渐变。亮部依然保留发丝般的细痕，暗部也有纹理，不会变成空洞的黑。画面拥挤，重复弧线与裁切边缘共同传递斜向动势。不均匀的纸质表面柔化完成面，却不遮盖准确的手绘轮廓。整体效果戏剧化、繁密而有运动感，印刷肌理将鲜明反差统一起来。
theme_en: Two travelers riding a rushing pale creature before a blue beast amid curling forms
theme_zh: 两位旅人骑在疾驰的浅色兽背上，后方蓝色巨兽隐现于卷曲形体间
name: Tsukioka Yoshitoshi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
